correctness.rationale: Exact rooted-forest enumeration gives P(C_n=k)=k(n)_k/n^(k+1). Forbidding incoming edges to s vertices reduces cyclic vertices to an independent uniform mapping on n-s vertices and proves the conditional factorial moments. Identical occupancy factorial moments determine the conditional law, and a monotone shared-ball coupling proves negative regression; Riemann-sum dominated convergence proves the sharp covariance. Exhaustive n<=6 verification yielded 241 assertions over 50,069 maps.

value.rationale: Cyclic core size and indegree-zero peripheral vertices are canonical mapping statistics. An exact occupancy representation and strict negative regression for all sizes is a motivated distributional dependence theorem, stronger than a routine moment identity. Growing |Cov|~sqrt(n) with decaying Corr~n^(-1/2) quantifies a previously unclassified dependence scale and clarifies multivariate asymptotics.
